name: Z5-TXT
description: Z5-TXT was a droid who worked on building a settlement in Quan-Shui and then worked in Cro-Akon. A group of Tectozin's went to slave droids building a settlement in Cro-Akon. Z5 was at a charging station but didn't have any energy to escape so Zeta sacrificed herself to give her energy to escape.
